name: Ainsworth no Mamono-tachi
original_name: エインズワースの魔物たち
source:
Klaus wanders around deep in the forest where people think monsters often appear. Why is Klaus there...? Several days ago, a bishop, his grandfather, passed away. All his fortune was supposed to be inherited by Klaus, but it was confiscated. Klaus lost everything and decided to go to where his late mother used to live, at the Ainsworth's Mansion that is located deep in the forest.... 

[Edited from [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/30_54/products_id/10345]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
克劳斯在森林深处徘徊，人们认为那里经常有怪物出没。克劳斯为什么会来到这里……？几天前，他身为主教的祖父去世了。原本应由克劳斯继承的全部财产遭到没收。失去一切的克劳斯决定前往亡母曾经生活的地方——坐落在森林深处的安斯沃思宅邸……
